legendNeed.t: X3: the displayed condition is the target, an all-order criterion or a zero-location input. To become a device it needs a proof step of type X1 or X2 at every prime inside the same inequality as s <-> 1-s.
legendNeed.c: X3: finite certificate (verified height, a box, a zero table). No arithmetic input turns it into a statement at all heights; it needs an X1 or X2 step that is uniform in height, with the functional equation.
legendNeed.L: X1 present (Lambda_F, Weil or Pick form, coefficients of 1/F), but the functional equation enters only through the archimedean term, a finite support or a mean value. Needs s <-> 1-s inside the same inequality in every window.
legendNeed.Z: X1 size or X2 exact local form present, used right of Re s = 1 or at single primes. Needs the functional equation in the same step (acting left of Re s = 1).
legendNeed.K: X5: kernel-shape condition that backward heat or Davenport-Heilbronn also satisfy. Needs an X1 or X2 step (unimodular local parameters at every prime) coupled to it.
